purpose: Eliminate the unreliable NSC SIA pixel transport while preserving all 139 frozen groups by resolving all 82 exposures to authoritative Archive files and every detector to the unique full-header WCS containing its frozen anchors.

archive_identity.authority: NSF NOIRLab Astro Data Archive public REST API
archive_identity.representative_coordinate_rule: For each exposure, use the coordinates of its lexicographically smallest frozen NSC object ID for metadata-only identity queries.
archive_identity.primary_identity_rule: Query the exact frozen exposure name and require one exact .fits or .fits.fz basename with matching DECam, InstCal, image, object and filter metadata.
archive_identity.fallback_identity_rule: Only if the exact basename is absent: for a c4d exposure, remove only its terminal processing-version token and require the unique most recently updated valid file with that full calibrated-image prefix; for a renamed tu exposure, derive c4d_YYMMDD_HHMMSS from its unique frozen ct4mYYYYMMDDtHHMMSS SIA association ID, require an ooi product with matching filter, and select the unique most recently updated valid row.

archive_header_resolution.selection_rule: Require exactly one two-dimensional celestial-WCS header in the selected Archive file to contain every frozen anchor assigned to the group.

retrieval.invalid_payload_retry_rule: HTTP failure, missing image data, malformed FITS, WCS mismatch, detector mismatch, non-finite image, or invalid present checksum keyword consumes one of the same three attempts and is never persisted.
retrieval.resume_rule: Reuse an existing exact V19AQ output only after fully revalidating it against the frozen structural, detector, WCS, finite-pixel and present-checksum gates.

claim_boundary: V19AQ changes transport only. All targets, exposure-extension memberships and coordinates remain frozen from V19AN/V19AM.
Exact frozen filenames are preferred; association fallback uses only already-frozen observation identity, product type, filter and archive update metadata.
Header-WCS containment selects the detector without reading flux, PSF, morphology, lensing, halo, or gravity outcomes.
A pass establishes complete calibrated detector retrieval and structural integrity only; it does not establish photometry, color, stellar mass, mass current, lensing, or Sigma-field validity.
Archive selected-HDU products may omit FITS CHECKSUM/DATASUM keywords; every exact downloaded payload receives a recorded SHA-256, and any checksum keyword that is present must validate.
